svg.title: Composable modular agent architecture — 3 layers
svg.desc: Three-layer architecture: Layer 1 universal core always on at bottom, Layer 2 add-on library organized by task type in middle, Layer 3 client-specific selected and personalized bundle at top. Arrows show the build-once deploy-many pattern.

g.text: Brand voice · API credentials · Custom policies · Niche config

svg.text: Built once. Reused across all clients. Organized by 5 task types — the true common layer across niches.
Layer 1 — universal core: always on, non-removable, every client.
4 clusters: Lifestyle · Home trades · Commerce · Professional — each maps to a predefined add-on subset.
